domain.note: US coastal and territorial network; actual station setting must be checked.

time.note: Record, datum and product availability vary by station.

screeningRule.access_note: Public API; build a request with the provider URL builder. A request needs station, product, dates, datum, units and time zone
screeningRule.basis: Conservative structured interpretation of the cited v0.1 catalog; this is not a new payload inspection.
screeningRule.note: Total water level is not storm-surge residual or overland flood depth. Match vertical datum and time zone.

sourceRecord.version: API snapshot; verified historical observations are preferred
sourceRecord.variable: Total observed water level; tidal predictions are a separate product
sourceRecord.units: Metres or feet, as requested, relative to an explicit station datum
sourceRecord.temporal_support: Six-minute or hourly observations in separate products
sourceRecord.temporal_coverage: Station- and variable-specific historical periods through selected archive snapshot
supported_use_cases: Derived nontidal residuals using compatible tide predictions
non_uses: Comparing a modeled surge residual with raw total water level
Treating a tide gauge as direct wave-runup or overland-depth truth
Using monthly means to validate storm peaks
limitations: Outages, station datums and epochs, and site representativeness require review. Distinguish preliminary from verified observations.
sourceRecord.dependence_notes: Check whether observations were used for model calibration or assimilation. A nontidal residual can contain processes beyond pure meteorological surge.
sourceRecord.access_method: Public API; build a request with the provider URL builder. A request needs station, product, dates, datum, units and time zone
sourceRecord.license_notes: Provider open-data terms; acknowledge source and retain version/record notices. Review any third-party restrictions.
unresolved_questions: Definition of the output of a model being evaluated
Actual sample response and quality flags

candidateSearch.distanceMethod: Spherical great-circle distance, mean Earth radius 6371.0088 km, minimized to original coordinate-linear GeoJSON edges; not an ellipsoidal survey distance.
notes: Point search radius: 100 km. All returned candidates within that radius are retained; distance is not a suitability ranking.
Both active and historical water-level station lists are searched and deduplicated; active IDs can be absent from the historical list. Listing does not establish observations during your dates.

Preview requests IGLD for stations marked Great Lakes by NOAA metadata, otherwise MSL; metres, GMT. The exact datum is retained with the response. Datum availability, reference epoch and hydrologic setting require review.

There is no overall station-count cap. Each action reads a manageable batch of provider pages; continue while another page is available. Provider metadata rows read may include repeated station IDs across series, lists or boxes.

coopsScreening.qualification: Metadata matches describe six-minute product/date/datum inventory only. Directory completion, attempted checks and actual preview responses are separate. Every loaded station remains exported, including mismatches and unchecked stations.

candidateSearch.qualification: All loaded candidates are exported without the display-page or text-filter limit. Completion is scoped to this provider route and query; it does not establish representative observations or complete data coverage.

F07.title: NOAA CO-OPS Data Retrieval API documentation
F07.claims: The water_level product returns preliminary or verified six-minute observations. A datum is required. GMT can be requested. Tide predictions are a separate product.

F08.title: NOAA: Data Inventory for The Battery, station 8518750
F08.claims: The listed verified six-minute water-level record covers Hurricane Sandy in 2012.

F09.title: NOAA: Inundation History for The Battery, station 8518750
F09.claims: The historical peak listing identifies Hurricane Sandy and an observed peak dated October 30, 2012 in the displayed record.

V024_COOPS_URL_BUILDER.title: NOAA CO-OPS API URL Builder
V024_COOPS_URL_BUILDER.claims: Provider tool that builds Data API requests for CO-OPS stations; links the API documentation. Example used here: The Battery (8518750), water_level, 29 to 30 Oct 2012, MLLW, GMT, metric.
